name: Vague termination rights or notice periods
description: Contracts using phrases like 'reasonable notice' without defining exact calendar days (e.g. 30, 60, or 90 days), allowing arbitrary eviction or abrupt cancellation.

name: Unclear payment terms or late-payment consequences
description: Agreements lacking defined payment milestones, bank details, grace periods, or containing vague penalty threats like 'landlord/client may take appropriate action'.

name: Unilateral price/fee changes
description: Clauses permitting one party to increase prices, fees, or rent without requiring mutual written consent or signed change-orders.

name: Auto-renewal without clear notice requirements
description: Locking the business into an automatic annual renewal unless canceled within a tiny, easily missed window, often accompanied by uncapped rent or rate spikes.

name: Unclear ownership of intellectual property
description: Client pays for custom software or creative deliverables but only receives a limited 'right to use', while the vendor retains all underlying code ownership.

name: Broad or unclear liability/indemnity clauses
description: One-sided clauses forcing the small business to indemnify the other party for unlimited damages, or capping the other party's liability to an ambiguous amount.

name: Confidentiality and business-data handling not clearly defined
description: Permitting broad third-party disclosures or failing to mandate strict deletion of proprietary data, credentials, and customer records upon contract expiry.

name: Unclear subcontracting/third-party access
description: Allowing the contractor to pass confidential work to unknown subcontractors without obtaining prior written client consent.

name: Missing scope, deliverables or acceptance criteria
description: Agreements leaving project scope to be 'discussed later as business needs arise', guaranteeing scope creep and unpaid revisions.

name: Tax/withholding responsibilities not clearly specified
description: Failing to specify whether amounts are gross or net of applicable FBR withholding tax (Section 153/155) and provincial sales tax (PRA/SRB), causing unexpected financial deductions.
